description: Fetch full per-input results for a completed native bulk job (created by `bulk_whois` or `bulk_email_verification`). If the job is still in flight, returns `status=running` with progress; the caller should retry. Per-input order may differ from the original input order. Do NOT use this for emulated bulk tools (`bulk_dns_lookup`, `bulk_subdomain_lookup`, `bulk_ip_geolocation`); they always return inline.

job_id.description: Opaque job identifier returned by a bulk_* tool when status=running.

name: bulk_job_results
